Headline: First Freight Futures ETF Focuses on Dry Bulk Shipping
Summary: The first freight futures-backed ETF, the Breakwave Dry Bulk Shipping ETF (BDRY), has launched, offering investors direct exposure to changes in global trade. Managed by Breakwave Advisors and ETF Managers Group, this actively managed ETF tracks dry bulk freight futures to measure rates for shipping dry bulk. It allocates to Capesize, Panamax, and Supramax contracts, with an initial allocation of 50%, 40%, and 10% respectively.
